query:
SELECT r.id, r.eventId, r.email, r.status, r.createdAt,
       e.title, e.eventDate
FROM registrations r
LEFT JOIN events e ON r.eventId = e.id
WHERE r.email = 'felipe.gomes.rp@gmail.com' AND r.status = 'approved'
ORDER BY e.eventDate DESC;
